title: subagent: Find when Aquinas image added to Wikipedia

content:
I need to find when a picture of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to the Wikipedia page on the "Principle of double effect".

The URL is: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principle_of_double_effect

Please use webfetch and websearch to:
1. Visit the Wikipedia page history at https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Principle_of_double_effect&action=history
2. Look through the edit history to find when an image of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added
3. Also check the current page to see what image exists and try to find when it was uploaded/added
4. Report the exact date (DD/MM/YYYY format) when the image was first added

If webfetch doesn't work, try websearch with specific queries like:
- "Principle of double effect" Wikipedia history Aquinas
- Thomas Aquinas image Wikipedia "Principle of double effect"
- Wikipedia file upload date Thomas Aquinas portrait

Return the exact date in DD/MM/YYYY format.
I'll help you find when a picture of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to the Wikipedia page on the "Principle of double effect". Let me start by checking the page history and the current page.

arguments.prompt: Find the edit history entries. Look for when an image of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to the page. Note the date and time of that edit, and what image was added. Also look for any mention of "Aquinas" or image uploads in the edit summaries.
